scope: Finite-dimensional boundary-zero family, Euclidean operator norms.

degree_conventions.spectral: J ceil(log(epsilon)/max_eigenvalue log|Psi_J(z)|); necessary for this constructed dictionary only
degree_conventions.actual: minimum kJ over integer k>=1 for which max(norm_2(B_F^k),norm_2(B_G^k)) <= epsilon
degree_conventions.search: All k<k_spec excluded by eigenvalues; exhaustive k_spec,...,k_actual in arbitrary precision. Nonmonotonicity is allowed.

all_1e-2_through_1e-8.convention: OLS log(d) = intercept + exponent log(1/alpha); complete-block degrees; equally weighted declared alpha points

tail_1e-4_through_1e-8.convention: OLS log(d) = intercept + exponent log(1/alpha); complete-block degrees; equally weighted declared alpha points
